material.obstacles_definition: LiveCuttingMaterial default for a task: the tool-profile handle box only (1 box), identical to the vector env without pad_boxes_edge (ADR 0021 workload A); no finger pads (fidelity reason no_finger_pad_obstacles)
material.initial_edge_pose: task.reference_edge_pose_world(0) (the planner HOME), reset seed = sim_seed

driver.definition: Compiled planner schedule (ConfiguredTaskSpec.reference_edge_pose_world(k*dt), k = 1..700; armed digit of step k = active_cut_index((k-1)*dt)) turned into edge_delta_v1 actions open loop by policies_batched.recorded_command_actions from reference_edge_pose_world(0). Inputs: scene, goal, tool profile and planner options only; no particle, label, component or oracle input.
driver.ideal_tracking: the material sees the reconstructed commanded edge poses (no robot, reaction not fed back)

evaluator.call: ConfiguredTaskSpec.evaluate_goal (= goals.evaluate_goal, frozen sever_mid goal), host, outside timing
evaluator.recording: t = 0 reference frame + a host snapshot every 10 control steps through step 700 (71 frames) for single-env rows; batched rows >= 36 frames (P1-2b evaluation stream every 20 steps)

success_rule: goals.evaluate_goal verdict == 'PASS' and nothing else. The shaping reward never decides success.

reward.definition: target = reference-lattice 6-neighbour bonds crossing a declared sever plane; off-target = bonds whose midpoint lies farther than the goal's frozen plane_error_bound_m (2 mm) from every plane; severed = tlmpm_v5._conflict_packed; r = w_p * d(severed target / n_target) - w_o * d(severed off-target / n_target) - time_penalty; invalid envs -invalid_penalty

single_env_reference.rows: T5.6 (ii): frozen single tlmpm_v7_2 LiveCuttingMaterial (one CUDA graph of 200 substeps), ideal tracking with the reference_command_policy_v1 commands, 3 separate processes (one device HashGrid each), headless, no Kit
